read.en: SpaceX fell 6.4% on Oct 30 to $134.72, its lowest close since Aug 20, trading between $134.50 and $140.20, with no 100-day yet (98 sessions). It is below the falling 5-day ($143.9), 10-day ($146.7) and 30-day ($152.4) averages. MACD has been below its signal since Oct 14, below zero, histogram widening; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 14 ($163.16), and RSI is 37.
read.zh: SpaceX 10月30日下跌 6.4%，收于 $134.72，为 8月20日以来最低收盘，盘中区间 $134.50–140.20；上市仅 98 个交易日，尚无 100 日均线。股价位于下行的 5 日（$143.9）、10 日（$146.7）和 30 日均线（$152.4）下方。MACD 自 10月14日起位于信号线下方且在零轴之下，柱状图扩大；抛物线 SAR 自 10月14日起看空（$163.16），RSI 为 37。

read.en: Two losses broke all three written supports, $144.1–144.6, $142.1 and $140.7 (Oct 15 low), now resistance, and the close sat near the day's low. Resistance is $140.2–140.7, then $142.1–143.9 (Oct 28 low, 5-day) and $146.7 (10-day). Support is $134–134.5 (Oct 30 and Aug 12 lows), then $130.2–130.4 (Aug 10 and 20 lows) and $120.4–122.1 (Jul 17 and 21 lows). A close above $140.7 would target $144; below $134, $130.
